item.title: CUR 2.0 Overview & Architecture
item.description:
AWS Data Exports CUR 2.0 Amazon S3

Estimated duration: 10 mins

CUR 2.0 Overview & Architecture

Overview

CUR 2.0 is the workshop financial evidence layer. AWS Data Exports delivers detailed cost and usage data to S3 for downstream analytics. Foundational Cloud Intelligence Dashboards support CUR 2.0 and AWS recommends it for the newer deployment path.

Learning Objectives

  • Understand the purpose of CUR 2.0.
  • Recognize major data categories.
  • Understand Parquet and S3 delivery.
  • Avoid assuming business dimensions exist automatically.

Why This Matters for FinOps

Dashboards can be replaced; the data foundation is harder to replace. Good FinOps starts with a stable, queryable billing record.

item.title: Prerequisites & AWS Identity Check
item.description:
AWS STS AWS CloudFormation AWS Billing

Estimated duration: 5 mins

Prerequisites & AWS Identity Check

Overview

This preflight prevents the most expensive workshop mistake: deploying billing infrastructure into the wrong account or Region.

Learning Objectives

  • Record the account ID.
  • Confirm the target Region.
  • Verify Billing and CloudFormation access.
  • Prepare source/destination account values for the single-account workshop.

Why This Matters for FinOps

Reliable cost governance starts with knowing which account owns the data pipeline and which identity changed it.

item.title: Deploy the CUR 2.0 Data Export Foundation
item.description:
AWS Data Exports AWS CloudFormation Amazon S3

Estimated duration: 15–20 mins

Deploy the CUR 2.0 Data Export Foundation

Overview

The workshop follows the official Cloud Intelligence Dashboards Data Exports deployment model. In the single-account test path, the same account can be both source and destination.

Learning Objectives

  • Understand destination-stack responsibilities.
  • Configure CUR 2.0 as the primary export.
  • Use the current AWS template as the source of truth.
  • Inspect created resources instead of treating CloudFormation as a black box.

Why This Matters for FinOps

The billing-data pipeline is production-like infrastructure: it has ownership, permissions, storage, and lifecycle costs.

item.title: Validate Data Export & S3 Delivery
item.description:
AWS Data Exports Amazon S3 CUR 2.0

Estimated duration: 10 mins + wait

Validate Data Export & S3 Delivery

Overview

CloudFormation success proves infrastructure creation, not data freshness. This lab separately verifies the Data Export configuration and eventual S3 delivery.

Learning Objectives

  • Verify the export exists.
  • Verify the destination bucket.
  • Understand the delivery prefix.
  • Record the first real Parquet delivery.

Why This Matters for FinOps

FinOps freshness depends on upstream data delivery. A dashboard can be healthy while the newest billing data has not yet arrived.
